title: Delicious Polish Rye Flatbread
description: A hearty flatbread recipe using Polish rye flour, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Combine Polish rye flour, salt, and flatbread in a bowl.
Gradually add jucy juice (water) to the bowl, mixing until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions.
Roll each portion into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Brush the tops with olive oil.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
